_comment: How to play's example cards (v0.8.6, docs/how-to-play.md): the guide shows each by its printed image from the API's Scryfall cache, over a text frame made from these fields. The API serves these names' images to anyone, signed in or not (GET /api/v1/how-to-play/card-images), and no others. Keys are the guide's own; text is each card's Oracle wording.

commandTower.name: Command Tower
rules: {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.

lightningBolt.name: Lightning Bolt
rules: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.

giantGrowth.name: Giant Growth
rules: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

wrathOfGod.name: Wrath of God
rules: Destroy all creatures. They can't be regenerated.

arcaneSignet.name: Arcane Signet
rules: {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.

pacifism.name: Pacifism
rules: Enchanted creature can't attack or block.

soulWarden.name: Soul Warden
rules: Whenever another creature enters, you gain 1 life.

prodigalSorcerer.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
rules: {T}: Prodigal Sorcerer deals 1 damage to any target.

ravenousChupacabra.name: Ravenous Chupacabra
rules: When Ravenous Chupacabra enters, destroy target creature an opponent controls.

chandra.name: Chandra, Torch of Defiance
rules: +1: Exile the top card of your library. You may cast that card. If you don't, Chandra, Torch of Defiance deals 2 damage to each opponent.
−3: Chandra, Torch of Defiance deals 4 damage to target creature.
−7: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a spell, this emblem deals 5 damage to any target."

raiseTheAlarm.name: Raise the Alarm
rules: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.

swordsToPlowshares.name: Swords to Plowshares
rules: Exile target creature. Its controller gains life equal to its power.

sigarda.name: Sigarda, Host of Herons
rules: Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause you to sacrifice permanents.

kenrith.name: Kenrith, the Returned King
rules: {R}: All creatures gain trample and haste until end of turn.
{1}{G}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
{4}{B}: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control.
